terms.name: Revenue
terms.description: Total recognized value of completed orders or payments. Used when analysts ask about sales, income, or recognized payment value.

terms.name: Customer Lifetime Value
terms.description: Estimated long-term economic value of a customer relationship across repeat purchases and retention.

terms.name: LTV
terms.description: Lifetime value — common synonym for customer lifetime value and customer worth in marketing analytics.

terms.name: customer worth
terms.description: Informal business synonym for customer lifetime value when stakeholders avoid finance jargon.

terms.name: Churn Risk
terms.description: Likelihood a customer stops buying or engaging. Related to attrition, disengagement, and retention risk.

terms.name: Attrition
terms.description: Customer attrition and disengagement. See-also concept for churn risk and why customers stop buying.

terms.name: Campaign ROI
terms.description: Return on marketing investment for campaigns. Covers campaign returns, payback, and marketing efficiency.

terms.name: Customer Segment
terms.description: Grouping of customers by behavior, value band, or lifecycle stage for targeting and analytics.
